name: moemodels-monorepo
description: Open tooling and evidence formats for planning, measuring, and verifying mixture-of-experts deployments.

scripts.build:ingest: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @moemodels/ingest
scripts.build:cli: npm run build:ingest && npm run build --workspace @moemodels/cli
scripts.build:policy: npm run build:bench && npm run build --workspace @moemodels/policy
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @moemodels/sdk
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @moemodels/mcp
scripts.build:launcher: npm run build:cli && npm run build:policy && npm run build --workspace moemodels
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:launcher && npm run build:sdk && npm run build:mcp
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:packages && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/ingest/test/*.test.mjs packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs packages/bench/test/*.test.mjs packages/policy/test/*.test.mjs packages/sdk/test/*.test.mjs packages/mcp/test/*.test.mjs packages/moemodels/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check:public-boundary && npm run test:unit && npm run test:package-smoke
scripts.registry:validate: npm run build:packages --silent && node packages/moemodels/dist/index.js validate --json
scripts.evaluations:validate: npm run build:packages --silent && node packages/moemodels/dist/index.js validate-evals --json
scripts.passport:verify: npm run build:bench --silent && node packages/bench/dist/cli.js verify
